theme.title: Full-Court Mix
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: Counting the regular season and playoffs together, how many games did the 1995–96 Bulls win?
questions.context: Chicago Bulls · 1995–96 · regular season plus playoffs
questions.note: 87 wins and 13 losses, the best combined record in NBA history.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 1995–96 Bulls have the best combined regular and postseason record in NBA history at 87–13

funFacts.text: That Bulls team introduced black alternate road uniforms with red pinstripes, a look closely associated with the dynasty.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bulls revealed new black alternate road uniforms, which featured red pinstripes

funFacts.text: Chicago reunited several former Detroit Bad Boys teammates by adding Rodman, James Edwards and John Salley.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rodman, Edwards and Salley were all teammates on the Detroit Pistons during the "Bad Boy" era

funFacts.text: The Bulls swept Orlando in the Eastern Conference finals, avenging the previous season's playoff elimination.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bulls swept the Magic to gain entry into the Finals

questions.prompt: In only their third season, how many games did the 1970–71 Bucks win?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Milwaukee posted a 66–16 record in only its third year of existence

funFacts.text: The arrival of Oscar Robertson gave young star Lew Alcindor a legendary partner.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: A key part of this championship season was the acquisition of Oscar Robertson

funFacts.text: Milwaukee beat the Baltimore Bullets in a four-game Finals sweep to win its first title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They faced off against the Baltimore Bullets and swept them in four games

funFacts.text: Role players included Lucius Allen, Bob Boozer and Dick Cunningham behind the star pairing.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: key reserves such as Lucius Allen, Bob Boozer and Dick Cunningham

questions.prompt: In the triple-overtime Game 5 of 1976, reserve Glenn McDonald scored how many points?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Glenn McDonald scored eight points in the game, all in overtime.

funFacts.text: Phoenix's Paul Westphal deliberately called a timeout the Suns didn't have to gain a tactical advantage.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Suns' Paul Westphal also intentionally called a timeout even though his team had no more remaining

funFacts.text: John Havlicek appeared to win the epic with a late basket, only for more time to remain on the clock.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Havlicek hit what appeared to be the game-winning shot at the end of the second overtime

funFacts.text: The dramatic winner came from a lightly used Boston reserve, not one of the celebrated starters.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Glenn McDonald, a little-used Celtic reserve player

questions.prompt: In Game 2 of the 2015 Finals, Stephen Curry set a Finals record for missed threes. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Curry set an NBA record for most missed three-point attempts in an NBA Finals game with 13.

funFacts.text: Matthew Dellavedova's physical defense held Curry scoreless from the field on his attempts against him.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Matthew Dellavedova's defense on Curry was huge as Curry was 0–for–8 against him

funFacts.text: The overtime victory was Cleveland's first Finals game win in franchise history, after its earlier sweep in 2007.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The victory for Cleveland was their first ever single game Finals victory

funFacts.text: LeBron dubbed the undermanned Cavs 'The Grit Squad' as injuries forced a slower, tougher style.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: James had dubbed the undermanned Cavaliers as "The Grit Squad"

questions.prompt: When Jokić and Murray made history with twin 30-point triple-doubles in the 2023 Finals, how many assists did they combine for?
questions.context: Jokić + Murray · Denver vs Miami · 2023 Finals Game 3
questions.note: 20 combined assists, matching Miami's entire team, as both stars logged 30-point triple-doubles.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: while their 20 assists matched Miami's total of 20.

funFacts.text: They were the first NBA teammates with 30-point triple-doubles in one game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jokić and Murray became the first pair of teammates in NBA history to each record a 30-point triple-double in the same game

funFacts.text: Denver retook the Finals lead in a comfortable win.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: as the Nuggets won 109–94, reclaiming the series lead

funFacts.text: The pair nearly matched all of Miami's rebounds.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: grabbing a combined 31 rebounds to the Heat's total of 33
